{{Quote|Some darn predator ate my good luck kima! I think those beasts have a lair near here. If you can find them and blast them to atoms, I'd certainly reward you.|Owner of a kima, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG" />}}
The '''kima''' (plural: '''kimas''') was a small [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Diet/Legends|herbivorous]] [[Canine/Legends|canines]] found in the wilds of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], one of the [[Double Worlds|Twin Worlds]] which [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] [[Centerpoint Station]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. Unique to the [[Planet/Legends|world]], kimas were a fast and agile [[Limb/Legends|quadruped]] which [[Hunting/Legends|hunted]] alone in remote rural areas. However, despite their solitary nature, they could still be found in packs. One of their most distinguishing features was their powerful and intimidating growl. Several different [[Subspecies/Legends|breeds]] of kima could be found on Talus, which although virtually indistinguishable in appearance, harbored at least some different behavioral characteristics. [[Beastmaster/Legends|Beast masters]] were able to train kimas as personal companions.

==Biology and appearance==
{{Listen|filename=Cr-kima-vocalize.flac|title=Kima vocalization|description=The intimidating growl of a kima {{C|''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''}}}}
The [[Diet/Legends|herbivorous]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Canine/Legends|canines]] known as kimas could be found in the wilds of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], one of the [[Double Worlds|Twin Worlds]] which [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] [[Centerpoint Station]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]].<ref name="SWG" /> The fast and agile [[Limb/Legends|quadrupeds]] were unique to the [[Planet/Legends|world]]. Kimas hunted alone in remote rural areas, and were known for their powerful and intimidating growl, which was said to set [[Heart/Legends|hearts]] pounding and turn knees to jelly.<ref name="SWG:K">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=loading|Kima|Talus}}</ref> The [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] [[vertebrate]]s had [[Cat/Legends|cat-like]] [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and bristly [[Color/Legends|gray]] hides while in the wild, but when domesticated, their [[Hair/Legends|hair]] could come in a variety of different hues, including shades of red, yellow and blue.<ref name="SWG" /> Kimas were very solitary, and would fight and scratch if bothered or touched. Kimas would not even associate with others of their own kind, [[Reproduction/Legends|mating]] only once per [[Standard year/Legends|year]], and spending no [[Time/Legends|time]] with their mates.<ref name="SWG:Bestiary">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Bestiary: "Talus"</ref> Despite their solitary nature,<ref name="SWG:K" /> kimas were known to form packs,<ref name="SWG" /> including the hilltop kima in particular, a [[Subspecies/Legends|breed]] of kima which tended to live in rugged areas. Slightly larger and more powerful than their cousins at lower altitudes, these creatures were known to travel alone or in packs.<ref name="SWG:HK">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=loading|Hilltop Kima|Talus}}</ref> Other breeds were present on Talus, such as the ferine razorfang, wolf kima, and woodland kima. All these breeds of kima were practically indistinguishable in appearance, but they harbored at least some differences in behavior. Kimas shared something of a physical resemblance to the [[Bearded jax/Legends|bearded jax]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] and [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. However, jax were [[Feline/Legends|felines]] rather than canines.<ref name="SWG" />

==History==
{{Quote|I'll sure miss that kima. I bet this breaks my incredible sabacc winning streak.|A kima owner|<ref name="SWG:RGLC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|NPC random mission: "Recover Good Luck Charm"}}</ref>}}
Kimas could be trained by [[Beastmaster/Legends|beast masters]] as personal companions or house pets. During the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]],<ref name="SWG" /> a predator [[Death/Legends|killed]] a kima belonging to a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] who relied on the kima for good luck. Disappointed by a potential end to their winning streak, the former pet owner sought to hire a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to eliminate a lair of beasts believed to be responsible for the kima's demise.<ref name="SWG:RGLC" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellia-based]] gang of criminals known as the [[Meatlumps]] kept a kima named [[Comet (kima)|Comet]] in a cage.<ref name="SWG:MtM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Muddle the Meatlumps|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[W:c:swg:Kima|Kimas]] first appeared as [[W:c:swg:Creatures & enemies|creatures]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> In addition to the standard kima, there also existed other named types of kimas, including the ferine razorfang, hilltop kima, [[Wolf/Legends|wolf]] kima, and woodland kima. Each of these were described or implied to be separate breeds of the same creature. Additionally, there also existed so-called feeble kimas, however unlike the aforementioned creatures, this seemed to merely be a descriptive name for certain kimas, rather than an entirely separate breed.<ref name="SWG" /> According to the game's directory tree files and source data, there were to be at least two other separate breeds of kima known as the [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] kima and [[Grass/Legends|grassland]] kima,<ref name="TRE">{{GalaxiesAED}} directory tree files and source data</ref> however neither of these were known to appear on the live servers.<ref name="SWG" />

There is perhaps some ambiguity regarding whether kimas should be considered canines, felines, or some combination thereof. The game depicted kimas with a cat-like growl, eyes, and some other appearance characteristics.<ref name="SWG" /> The game's directory tree files and source data also list kimas as a type of "cat," in a similar vein to the bearded jax or [[kittle]].<ref name="TRE" /> However, kimas were not explicitly described as cat-like in the game itself. Instead, they were described as forming packs, and the existence of a breed of kima known as the ''wolf'' kima seems to suggest they were intended to be canines.<ref name="SWG" />

Early in the game's lifespan, dynamically spawned non-player characters offered a variety of simple [[W:c:swg:Quest|missions]].<ref name="SWG" /> In one case, NPCs could offer a destroy mission titled "Recover Good Luck Charm," the storyline of which featured a kima. The mission required the player to destroy creatures at an assigned [[W:c:swg:Waypoint|waypoint]] in exchange for a [[W:c:swg:Imperial Credit|credit]] reward.<ref name="SWG:RGLC" /> With the release of [[W:c:swg:Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies'']], kimas could be [[W:c:swg:Tame (Ability)|tamed]] as [[W:c:swg:Pets|pets]] by players who pursued the [[W:c:swg:Creature Handler|creature handler]] [[W:c:swg:Professions (pre-NGE)|profession]].<ref name="SWG" /> Following the release of [[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15 2005|Publish 25's]] [[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]] on [[November 15]], [[2005]],<ref name="NGE">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> creature handlers were removed.<ref name="SWG:NGE">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref> However, with the release of [[W:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild]] on [[May 22]], [[2007]], [[W:c:swg:Beast Master|beast masters]] were added as an [[W:c:swg:Expertise|expertise]] path,<ref name="Chapter6">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=66959&resource=publish#chapter6|text=Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref> allowing players to incubate creatures as pets.<ref name="SWG:NGE" />
